name: spicy-themes
description: A Spicetify extension that lets you customize the theme of Spicy Lyrics with colors, effects, fonts, and more!

scripts.deploy: npm run build && copy dist\spicy-themes.js "%APPDATA%\spicetify\Extensions\" && spicetify apply
scripts.release: npm run build && copy dist\spicy-themes.js builds\spicy-themes.js

author: 7xeh
